verdict.rationale: Whether a note-taking app's source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Capacities' source code is public or openly licensed. The API, the OpenAPI spec, the npm SDK and the MCP integration are developer interfaces, not open product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
